name: claude-autoresearch-mod-dev
description: Development workspace for the autoresearch Claude Code mod (the shippable plugin is plugin/).

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:plugin
scripts.test:plugin: cd plugin && CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 claude plugin test .
scripts.validate: cd plugin && CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 claude plugin validate . --strict
